notice.title: Synthetic test rules
notice.body: This environment runs fictional test rules that exercise the workflow engine. They aren't HR or legal guidance and don't reflect any approved HeroOS methodology.

message.title: Test caution: the issue was raised before
message.body: A fictional caution shown when the issue was raised before. It exists only to exercise warnings and acknowledgments.

stages.title: Test stage 1: Check-in conversation
stages.summary: A fictional first stage: record whether a test check-in conversation took place.

checklist.prompt: Has the test check-in conversation taken place?
checklist.label: Test check-in held

checklist.prompt: Did the employee have a chance to give their view in the test conversation?
checklist.label: Employee's view heard (test)

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: Both test check-in answers must be Yes before this fictional stage can be completed.

stages.title: Test stage 2: Written note
stages.summary: A fictional second stage: record whether a test note was shared with the employee.

checklist.prompt: Was the test note shared with the employee?
checklist.label: Test note shared

message.title: Test order: check-in first
message.body: The fictional check-in stage must be completed before the test note.

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The test note must have been shared before this fictional stage can be completed.

message.title: Test caution: no supporting evidence confirmed
message.body: A fictional caution shown when supporting evidence isn't confirmed. It exists only to exercise warnings.

stages.title: Test stage 3: Final review
stages.summary: A fictional last stage. Completing it ends the test workflow; it decides nothing about the employee.

checklist.prompt: Has the test review been carried out?
checklist.label: Test review done

checklist.prompt: Does this test case need outside help?
checklist.label: Outside help needed (test)

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The test review must be done before this fictional stage can be completed.

message.title: Test escalation: specialist review needed
message.body: A fictional escalation: this test case needs specialist review before it can continue. HeroOS hasn't contacted anyone.

stages.title: Test stage A: Written notice
stages.summary: A fictional first stage of the test serious pathway.

checklist.prompt: Was the test notice given to the employee?
checklist.label: Test notice given

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The test notice must have been given before this fictional stage can be completed.

stages.title: Test stage B (optional): Paid pause
stages.summary: A fictional optional stage. It can be skipped by starting the test meeting instead.

checklist.prompt: Is the test pause fully paid?
checklist.label: Test pause fully paid

message.title: Test escalation: unpaid pause
message.body: A fictional escalation for a test pause that isn't confirmed as fully paid.

stages.title: Test stage C: Meeting
stages.summary: A fictional meeting stage of the test serious pathway.

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The test meeting must have been held before this fictional stage can be completed.

stages.title: Test stage D: Employer's record
stages.summary: A fictional last stage. Completing it ends the test workflow; it decides nothing about the employee.

checklist.prompt: Has the employer kept a test record?
checklist.label: Test record kept

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The test record must be kept before this fictional stage can be completed.

stages.title: Test DIFC stage: Review
stages.summary: A fictional DIFC-only stage, different from every UAE Federal test stage.

checklist.prompt: Has the DIFC-only test check been done?
checklist.label: DIFC test check done

message.title: Test requirement not met
message.body: The DIFC-only test check must be done before this fictional stage can be completed.
